definitions.explanation: The number eight when counting things using native Japanese numbers.

examples.japanese: {八|やっ}つ⟦{残|のこ}って→残る：01187_nokoru⟧⟦います→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦みかん→みかん：01036_mikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{八|やっ}つ⟦{買|か}いました→買う：00489_kau⟧。
⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{八|やっ}つ⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧⟦{答|こた}えられた→答える：01099_kotaeru⟧。
examples.english: There were eight questions, but I could answer all of them.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{八|やっ}つ⟦になった→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{自転車|じてんしゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦あげた→あげる：00546_ageru⟧。
examples.english: My child turned eight, so I bought them a bicycle.

notes:
{八|やっ}つ is the native Japanese number for counting eight general items.

NATIVE COUNTING SYSTEM (1-10):
- ⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧ (1), ⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧ (2), ⟦{三|みっ}つ→三つ：02970_mittsu⟧ (3), ⟦{四|よっ}つ→四つ：03039_yottsu⟧ (4), ⟦{五|いつ}つ→五つ：02892_itsutsu⟧ (5)
- ⟦{六|むっ}つ→六つ：02974_muttsu⟧ (6), ⟦{七|なな}つ→七つ：02926_nanatsu⟧ (7), {八|やっ}つ (8), ⟦{九|ここの}つ→九つ：02902_kokonotsu⟧ (9), ⟦{十|とお}→十：28376_too⟧ (10)

WHEN TO USE:
- General objects without specific counters
- Age up to 9: {八|やっ}つ = 8 years old
- Abstract things: ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{八|やっ}つ (eight problems)

CHINESE VS. NATIVE:
- ⟦{八|はち}→八：00698_hachi⟧: Sino-Japanese (used with counters)
- {八|やっ}つ: Native Japanese (standalone counting)

EXAMPLE CONTRAST:
- ⟦みかん→みかん：01036_mikan⟧を{八|やっ}つ: eight oranges (native)
- ⟦みかん→みかん：01036_mikan⟧を⟦{八|はち}→八：00698_hachi⟧⟦{個|こ}→〜個：00645_ko⟧: eight oranges (Sino-Japanese + counter)
